issues.detail: The Greek 'ακροβυστια' (akrobystia) means 'uncircumcised'. The Vietnamese translation renders this as 'sự không cắt bì', but the structure of the sentence in Vietnamese makes it sound like a title or a noun phrase ('bởi tay người ta gọi là sự không cắt bì') rather than describing the state of the people. More importantly, the Greek says 'the [uncircumcised] called [uncircumcised]', while the Vietnamese phrasing 'những kẻ xưng là sự cắt bì' (those who claim to be circumcision) is a confusing rendering of 'οι λεγομενοι ακροβυστια'.
